The top 10 comedians left put their roasting skills to the test, with Marshawn Lynch as the guest of honor. Many people were burned. Some were even scorched. Only 8 comics will get into the next round. Funny AF with Kevin Hart is now playing
About Netflix Is A Joke: The official hub of Netflix stand-up, comedy series, films, and all things funny — curated by the world’s most advanced algorithm and a depressed, yet lovable, cartoon horse. Their unlikely friendship is our story…
